remarks: Newly renovated spacious 1 bedroom condo in the heart of Springdale. Key features include new flooring, stainless-steel appliances, a same-floor laundry room, and a reserved parking space. Building amenities offer an updated lobby, mailroom, and exercise room, with heat, hot water, and gas included in the HOA. The property is walking distance to the train, shopping, and recreation, and near Sterling Farms Golf Course.
